leadText:
Marris (Japanese: モリシマ Morishima) is a minor recurring character in .

She first appeared in Jostling for the Junior Cup!, where she participated in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup and was 's first opponent. However, she was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament. She made a cameo appearance in Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!, where she lined up with all the other competitors in front of Alder, Cynthia, Caitlin and Freddy O'Martian.
